captions.detailed: This object is a skylight sunroof cassette, consisting of a rectangular outer frame, a small fixed glass section on one end, and a movable vent insert on the other. The entire unit is rendered in a uniform matte light gray material. The sliding vent insert is designed to translate prismatically along guide rails embedded on the inside walls of the main panel frame, allowing it to slide rearward to open.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a vent-only skylight sunroof cassette with a fixed glass panel and a movable rear-sliding vent insert. The vent insert must slide prismatically on guide rails inside the main outer frame.
captions.factory: The code constructs a main base frame as a hollowed-out rectangular box with a central partition separating the fixed and sliding sections. It then defines a sliding vent insert as a separate rectangular plate. A prismatic joint is established between the base frame and the sliding insert, oriented along the longitudinal axis, with motion limits defining its range of travel.
